title: Baked lamb, cabbage and celeriac fritters

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Lamb mince, cabbage, celeriac, eggs, flour, yoghurt and lemon are all plain home staples with no factory-made products.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday Tesco item at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray, grater, bowl and knife, and the technique is simple mixing and baking.

works.reason: The egg and flour should bind the meat and vegetables, and thin fritters at 220°C for 25 minutes on a hot oiled tray will cook the lamb through; 300g lamb plus 550g veg makes a fair lunch for four.

honest_times.reason: Shredding cabbage, peeling and grating celeriac, mixing and spooning out 16 fritters fits about 20 minutes, and the 25-minute bake matches the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including cumin and lemon, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Hot baked fritters suit a February lunch, and white cabbage is a main bulk ingredient named in the title.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English a neighbour would give.

hearty_healthy.reason: Lamb, cabbage and celeriac fritters with yoghurt make a proper balanced meal a family would eat again.
